blurb: Italiana Tours offers immersive painting workshops and retreats in the Le Marche region of Italy. Guests participate in studio and plein air painting sessions, creative workshops such as paper making and bookbinding, and cultural excursions to historical towns and local artisan sites. The retreats include guided instruction by established artists and opportunities to explore local cuisine and traditions.
